incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: magnolia-bank (enterprise VPC) — possible unredacted PII found in logs forwarded to external ELK cluster. Severity: P2. Pager: jia (oncall). Please join thread and acknowledge.
jia (oncall): acked. paging in ENG/SRE/LEGAL/CS. seeing increased error rates from magnolia-prod-3 dedicated pool.
arman (eng): on it. quick q — is this from request/response bodies or internal debug logs?
jia (oncall): looks like request payloads from their webhook endpoint. sample shows SSNs and full names. forwarding snippet to legal off-thread.
priya (legal): received. immediate questions: has any of the exported log bundle been shared outside the customer's VPC? who has access to the ELK instance?
marco (cs): magnolia's security contact (magnolia-sec-contact) says they pulled logs into their vendor-managed ELK earlier today for analysis. they requested it.
magnolia-sec-contact: confirming — we requested full logs for debugging replication of a billing issue. we were not expecting unredacted PII. we can pause ingest if needed.
kevin (sre): action: pause forwarding pipeline to external ELK now. running isolation command on the tenant log forwarder.
kevin (sre): ```bash
# isolate tenant log forwarder
POST /internal/tenants/magnolia-bank/forwarding/_pause
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/tenants/magnolia-bank/forwarding/pause" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN"
```
kevin (sre): done — forwarding paused at 2026-03-15T03:28:27Z. no new logs will be sent out.
arman (eng): snapshotting the current ELK indices and moving to secure S3 bucket with restricted ACLs and KMS key. creating immutable snapshot for legal review.
arman (eng): ```bash
# create snapshot
curl -X PUT "https://elk.internal/_snapshot/magnolia-incident-1789394123?wait_for_completion=true"
# copy to secure S3
aws s3 cp /snapshots/magnolia-incident-1789394123 s3://redwood-secure-incident-store/magnolia/ --sse aws:kms
```
priya (legal): we need (1) exact list of exposed fields, (2) timeframe (first/last timestamp of unredacted entries), (3) list of people with access to the snapshot and ELK, and (4) customer's written waiver/consent to retain the snapshot for investigation beyond our standard retention.
marco (cs): magnolia wants a debug window — they propose 72 hours of retained access to the snapshot. request from their CTO.
priya (legal): internal policy: retention >30 days or any PII retention beyond normal retention requires signed exception + audit entries. short exception (72 hrs) can be approved if we (a) limit access to named users, (b) log all access to audit trail, (c) delete snapshot at end of window and provide deletion proof. need signed waiver from customer security and CISO.
jia (oncall): immediate mitigation plan proposed: 1) pause forwarding (done), 2) create secured snapshot (in progress), 3) run redaction pipeline to produce scrubbed logs copy for ongoing debugging, 4) grant magnolia read-only access to scrubbed copy via time-limited presigned URL, 5) require signed waiver for access to original snapshot if needed.
arman (eng): pushing a redaction job to log-redactor service now. rule set: mask 9-digit numbers, names to initials, emails to hashed tokens. quick python filter: ```python
def redact(line):
    line = re.sub(r"\b\d{3}-?\d{2}-?\d{4}\b", "[REDACTED_SSN]", line)
    line = re.sub(r"(\b[A-Z][a-z]+\s[A-Z][a-z]+\b)", lambda m: m.group(1).split()[0][0]+". "+m.group(1).split()[1][0]+".", line)
    return line
```
kevin (sre): redaction job submitted to cluster redactor-01. running on snapshot copy only (not original). estimated completion 18m.
priya (legal): record this chat as the incident justification. once magnolia signs waiver, Legal will log the exception in the compliance ledger and add required controls (named user list, 2FA requirement, limited IP allowlist).
magnolia-sec-contact: we will prepare a signed waiver and share via our secure docs. prefer last-resort access to original snapshot — first want scrubbed copy to continue debug.
marco (cs): customer asked also whether we can rotate KMS key used to encrypt the snapshot after deletion as extra proof. is that doable?
arman (eng): yes, rotation is doable after deletion. we'll also publish a deletion proof: md5 of deleted object removed from bucket + S3 delete marker + audit log entry.
priya (legal): also require a hold on any automated backups/cold archives for this tenant while the exception is active — no secondary copies allowed.
jia (oncall): noted. I'll update incident timeline and add handoff. night oncall @kevin (sre) will take over at 00:00 UTC. current status: forwarding paused, snapshot taken, redaction in progress, legal initiated waiver request, customer preparing signed consent.
kevin (sre): taking over at 00:00. will monitor redaction job finish and confirm scrubbed copy delivery.
priya (legal): if magnolia signs waiver before EOD UTC, Legal will approve a 72-hour access window limited to 5 named people. otherwise no access to original snapshot.
magnolia-sec-contact: understood, will expedite. thanks for quick containment.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: magnolia-bank — severity remains P2. Actions logged in #incidents-tracker ticket INC-2026-4773. Audit note: forwarding paused, snapshot created, redaction job started.
jia (oncall): closing loop for now. I'll add remediation tasks to the ticket: add mandatory redaction rules for webhook endpoints, opt-in per-tenant masking config, and docs for legal/CS flow for retention waivers.
kevin (sre): handoff acknowledged. leaving detailed runbook in the ticket and tagging @priya (legal) and @marco (cs) for follow-up.
priya (legal): will follow up with waiver template and compliance entry. keep me looped for any additional exposures.
marco (cs): will update customer-facing incident timeline and confirm when scrubbed copy is available. :white_check_mark:
